==== inferenceDiscriminantInstantiatedProperties.ts (1 errors) ====
    // Discriminants whose types come from instantiating a type parameter or a mapped type template still
    // discriminate when inferring, while instantiated properties of object types are never treated as ones.
    
    interface Box<K, V> {
        kind: K;
        value: V;
    }
    
    type Boxes<T> = Box<"a", T> | Box<"b", { inner: T }>;
    declare function fromBoxes<T>(boxes: Boxes<T>): T;
    
    interface Carrier<K, V> {
        kind: K;
        value: V;
        next: Carrier<K, V> | undefined;
        describe(): string;
    }
    
    declare const carrierA: Carrier<"a", string>;
    const fromInstantiatedA = fromBoxes(carrierA);
    
    declare const carrierB: Carrier<"b", { inner: number }>;
    const fromInstantiatedB = fromBoxes(carrierB);
    
    declare const readonlyB: Readonly<{ kind: "b"; value: { inner: boolean } }>;
    const fromMappedB = fromBoxes(readonlyB);
    
    declare const pickedB: Pick<{ kind: "b"; value: { inner: bigint }; extra: number }, "kind" | "value">;
    const fromPickedB = fromBoxes(pickedB);
    
    declare function fromBox<T>(box: { kind: "a"; value: T }): T;
    declare const unionOfCarriers: Carrier<"a", string> | Carrier<"b", number>;
    const fromUnionOfCarriers = fromBox(unionOfCarriers); // error
